  coalesce(sum(sr.sr_return_amt), 0) AS numer_return_amt,
  round(coalesce(sum(sr.sr_return_amt), 0) / sum(ss.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr

 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9;
